## Changelog
### Fixed
- Fixed server processes messages from clients that never said hello.
- Fixed bulk Add can create duplicate squawks and CIDs.
- Fixed combos clears and refills combos on every refresh.
- Fixed bug that lets strip deletion bypass the two step process.
- Fixed layout description is parsed as HTML.
- Fixed info block spin boxes fire on every keystroke.
- Fixed late-joining clients never get current info-block data.
- Fixed saving a bookmark with a new label silently does nothing.
- Fixed no auto-scroll while dragging in a tall column.
- Fixed rename, delete and clone silently do nothing for the wrong layout type.
- Fixed autosave is stale after clearing the board and isn’t atomic.
- Fixed one malformed networking packet raises inside a slot.
- Fixed a hand-edited `keybinds.json` that isn’t a dict crashes startup.
- Fixed layout rename rewrites the JSON non-atomically.
- Fixed a strip that becomes visible appears at the bottom of its column.
- Fixed “split below” appends at the end instead of below the clicked column.
- Fixed loading a layout or restoring an autosave doesn’t resync the network.
- Fixed columns accept any text drag, including text dragged in from other apps.
### Changed
- Changed how some elements interact to improve performance.
